purpose: Measure finite-segment phase bias and uncertainty coverage as an auxiliary diagnostic, without changing the fixed detection rule or primary multiplicity allocation.
seed: SeedSequence([row seed...,919]); fixed per independent experiment
interval: production segment-percentile circular phase offsets, confidence 0.95
coverage_uncertainty: unadjusted one-sided exact bounds at delta=0.025 reported as a two-sided 95% interval per family; descriptive, not a simultaneous primary gate
claim_limit: No prospective uncertainty coverage claim is granted by a detection gate; compare measured coverage and disclose undercoverage. No threshold tuning.
